targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    status AS "Status"
FROM monitoring.pipeline_runs
WHERE dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    duration_seconds
FROM monitoring.pipeline_runs
WHERE dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    postgres_row_count
FROM monitoring.pipeline_runs
WHERE dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    dbt_status AS "dbt Status"
FROM monitoring.pipeline_runs
WHERE dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    started_at AS "time",
    duration_seconds AS "Pipeline duration"
FROM monitoring.pipeline_runs
WHERE
    dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND duration_seconds IS NOT NULL
    AND $__timeFilter(started_at)
ORDER BY started_at;

SELECT
    pipeline_run_id AS "Run ID",
    started_at AS "Started",
    status AS "Status",
    ROUND(duration_seconds::numeric, 2) AS "Duration (s)",
    raw_row_count AS "Raw",
    bronze_row_count AS "Bronze",
    silver_row_count AS "Silver",
    postgres_row_count AS "PostgreSQL",
    dbt_status AS "dbt",
    failed_task_id AS "Failed Task"
FROM monitoring.pipeline_runs
WHERE dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    q.metric_value::double precision AS "Schema Drift Fields"
FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q
JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
    ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id
WHERE
    p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND q.layer = 'BRONZE'
    AND q.metric_name = 'schema_drift_field_count'
ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    q.metric_value::double precision AS "Company Information"
FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q
JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
    ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id
WHERE
    p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND q.layer = 'SILVER'
    AND q.metric_name = 'company_information_pct'
ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    q.metric_value::double precision AS "Salary Availability"
FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q
JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
    ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id
WHERE
    p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND q.layer = 'SILVER'
    AND q.metric_name = 'salary_available_pct'
ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
    q.metric_value::double precision AS "Coordinates Availability"
FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q
JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
    ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id
WHERE
    p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND q.layer = 'SILVER'
    AND q.metric_name = 'coordinates_pct'
ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_run AS (
    SELECT
        q.pipeline_run_id
    FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q
    JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
        ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id
    WHERE
        p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
        AND q.layer = 'SILVER'
        AND q.metric_name = 'row_count'
    ORDER BY p.started_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
)

SELECT
    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN q.layer = 'BRONZE'
            THEN q.metric_value::double precision
        END
    ) AS "Bronze",

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN q.layer = 'SILVER'
            THEN q.metric_value::double precision
        END
    ) AS "Silver"

FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q
WHERE
    q.pipeline_run_id = (
        SELECT pipeline_run_id
        FROM latest_run
    )
    AND q.metric_name = 'row_count'
    AND q.layer IN ('BRONZE', 'SILVER');

SELECT
    p.started_at AS "time",

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN q.metric_name = 'company_information_pct'
            THEN q.metric_value::double precision
        END
    ) AS "Company Information",

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN q.metric_name = 'salary_available_pct'
            THEN q.metric_value::double precision
        END
    ) AS "Salary Availability",

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN q.metric_name = 'coordinates_pct'
            THEN q.metric_value::double precision
        END
    ) AS "Coordinates Availability"

FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q

JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
    ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id

WHERE
    p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND q.layer = 'SILVER'
    AND q.metric_name IN (
        'company_information_pct',
        'salary_available_pct',
        'coordinates_pct'
    )
    AND $__timeFilter(p.started_at)

GROUP BY
    p.pipeline_run_id,
    p.started_at

ORDER BY
    p.started_at;

SELECT
    p.started_at AS "time",

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN q.layer = 'BRONZE'
            THEN q.metric_value::double precision
        END
    ) AS "Bronze",

    MAX(
        CASE
            WHEN q.layer = 'SILVER'
            THEN q.metric_value::double precision
        END
    ) AS "Silver"

FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q

JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
    ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id

WHERE
    p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND q.metric_name = 'row_count'
    AND q.layer IN ('BRONZE', 'SILVER')
    AND $__timeFilter(p.started_at)

GROUP BY
    p.pipeline_run_id,
    p.started_at

ORDER BY
    p.started_at;

SELECT
    p.started_at AS "time",
    q.metric_value::double precision AS "Drift Fields"
FROM monitoring.data_quality_metrics q
JOIN monitoring.pipeline_runs p
    ON p.pipeline_run_id = q.pipeline_run_id
WHERE
    p.dag_id = 'france_travail_job_market_pipeline'
    AND q.layer = 'BRONZE'
    AND q.metric_name = 'schema_drift_field_count'
    AND $__timeFilter(p.started_at)
ORDER BY p.started_at;
